step0.title: Glad you're here.
step0.body: Mensaena is your place for lived neighbourhood help. In six short steps we show you how to settle in safely and effortlessly.

step1.title: Everything at a glance.
step1.body: On the dashboard you find all key info at a glance: new requests, offers from your neighbourhood, and personal recommendations.

step2.title: Help nearby.
step2.body: On the interactive map you see where help is needed or offered near you. Tap a pin and meet your neighbours.

step3.title: Share what you can offer or seek.
step3.body: Whether you're lending tools, helping with shopping or needing support — a post takes only seconds.

step4.title: Talk directly with each other.
step4.body: Everything between neighbours runs via secure direct messages. Friendly, respectful, GDPR-compliant.

step5.title: Stronger together.
step5.body: Mensaena thrives on togetherness. Be respectful, helpful and open — you'll soon feel how warm your neighbourhood is.
